s1.desc: a home kitchen with an arched doorway, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a dining nook with a round table and wooden chairs, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: opening drift: the background slides diagonally and settles at f19 (patch tracking on the arch and the counter)

spans.view: with a cream couch seen through the arch behind them and a turquoise kitchen counter on the right

beats.text: Polly holds a red rose out toward Pax with a shy smile while he stands facing her with a stern frown
Pax takes the rose from Polly's outstretched fin
Pax leans back with his eyes squeezed shut and flings the rose away while Polly clasps her fins together
Pax hops and lands with his eyes closed as the rose drops to the floor, while Polly watches with her fins at her chest

spans.notes: arch and counter tracked: no shift f19-54 (compare 19/54 arch edges black)
Pax alone by a round table: slow pan (compare 56/77 doubled table edges), then a zoom out f78-92 revealing Polly beside him, then a small drift that settles at f106 (chair patch tracked)

beats.text: Pax spins all the way around on the spot with a fin raised while Polly reaches a fin out toward him
Pax flips head over heels toward the front and slides away out of view to the right
Polly lowers her fin and glances to the side with a puzzled look
Polly stands alone by the table, blinking and looking around in confusion

spans.notes: keep12 low from Pax's big flips; right chair tracked with zero shift f106-158 (compare 106/120, 120/158 chair edges black). size_change true: Pax tumbles toward the front of the picture
15-frame close view of Polly with fins clasped, swaying happily
new two-shot in the kitchen; background still sliding, settles at f184 (arch patch tracked)

spans.view: with a cream couch seen through the arch behind them and a turquoise kitchen counter on the right

beats.text: Polly leans in toward Pax with her eyes closed and her fins stretched out as little hearts float up, while Pax holds her off with one fin, frowning

spans.notes: ends at f205, before Pax pulls out the iFin (visible from f205) and shows its screen with a photo of Polly (f207-244)
Pax pulls out the iFin (f205-206, back clearly iFin) and holds up its screen showing a lock-screen photo of Polly f207-244
8 frames: Pax lowers the iFin and smiles with his eyes closed while Polly clasps her fins
